description: Implementation of a text-to-speech (TTS) service class 'PiperTTSService' that integrates with Piper's HTTP TTS server, supporting streaming audio generation, metrics, and error handling.

classes.name: PiperTTSService
classes.description: A class that implements a TTS service using Piper's HTTP API, supporting streaming, metrics, and error handling.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the PiperTTSService with base URL, aiohttp session, and optional sample rate.

methods.name: can_generate_metrics
methods.description: Indicates that this service supports metrics generation.

methods.name: run_tts
methods.description: Asynchronously generates speech audio frames from input text by calling Piper's HTTP API, handling errors and streaming frames.
